instructions: heat olive oil in medium saucepan over medium high heat . add uncooked rice , tumeric , salt , and pepper . stir rice occasionally until it is toasted and starts to smell nutty . add vegetable stock and coconut milk and stir well . bring to boil and then turn the heat down to maintain a simmer . cover and simmer for 15 minutes . remove rice from heat and stir in almonds . serve immediately .
